cycle: next study item or a named stop

invariants.statement: Self-study reads, thinks and learns: the study runtime has no executor, no provider, no network client, and writes nothing outside the durable learning store.
A claim becomes verified knowledge only when the quote supporting it is actually present in the source it names; model assertion alone never verifies anything.
Verified knowledge, inference and unverified observation are stored apart, and confidence follows the kind the runtime determined rather than any model-supplied number.
Every retained study item carries its source reference, source type, source digest, timestamp, scope, verification state and model provenance.
The curriculum is bounded by an item budget and every mission terminates with a named stop reason; there is no open-ended research loop.
Current authoritative truth outranks retained study knowledge: contradicted items are withheld from reuse and items whose source changed are surfaced as stale.
Study cannot approve or promote a skill, widen authority, modify governance, deploy, merge, or cause any external effect, and studied content never removes scope confirmation.
Study reuses the one durable learning store; it creates no parallel knowledge authority and no second execution path.
Retained study knowledge belongs to BRO and survives a model or provider change; model identity is recorded as provenance only.
A plain 'study X' request is routed to STUDY automatically without the operator choosing a mode; STUDY requires no confirmation and reaches no executor.

Mission-derived hints reorder which already-discovered sources are offered first; they select nothing outside the study root, never exclude the rest, and a hint set that matches nothing falls back to the full set and says so.

A mission's CURRICULUM_COMPLETE means one bounded plan finished and never that the long programme finished. Programme coverage is derived from the one durable memory rather than kept beside it, and is reported separately from the mission's stop reason.

Master-curriculum coverage is derived from satisfied curriculum requirements, and a requirement is satisfied only by VERIFIED knowledge retained from the canonical documents the manifest declares for it. Which words a claim contains decides nothing.

Sufficiently studied sources are withheld from planning by the runtime, not by prompt wording. A revisit happens only on a named reason -- contradiction, staleness, missing verification, dependency depth, insufficient coverage or an explicit refresh -- and every revisit is recorded with that reason.

The planner receives a bounded structured view of durable state: covered, partial and unstudied domains, the unsatisfied requirement in front and the canonical entry point that would close it, already-studied sources and permitted revisits. The knowledge base itself is never handed to the model.
Every acquisition candidate's outcome is durably recorded and named, so a mission that acquired nothing can be explained from evidence rather than guessed at.

A curriculum requirement whose authoritative publisher is claimed by no admitted source family is reported as SOURCE_GAP, by publisher and host. It is never satisfied, never given a fabricated source, never resolved by BRO admitting the publisher itself, and never silently removed from the curriculum: admitting a publisher is a governance decision.

truth_boundary.repository_claim: Bounded curriculum planning, root-bounded read-only source access, source-quote verification, kind separation, provenance, contradiction and staleness handling, named stop conditions and automatic STUDY routing are implemented and testable.
not_claimed: Autonomous model-weight training or fine-tuning of any kind
Arbitrary self-modifying code or automatic installation of generated code
Correctness or completeness of every model-proposed claim
Any authority, approval or promotion arising from studied content
Network research beyond the declared local study root
Production study evidence before host rollout, readback and a live study mission
truth_boundary.repetition: Studying a subject again is allowed only for a stated reason, and the reason is written down.
